description: Committed, product-neutral audit-objective registry. The registry digest is bound at campaign start and immutable during a campaign; the objective for a round is selected deterministically from the round number. Objectives are falsification lenses, never implementation tasks or project memory.

objectives.title: Fresh-context isolation
objectives.objective: Falsify the claim that every role runs in a fresh context with only the §5.1 authoritative inputs: prove that no session resume, memory injection, scratchpad, prior conversation, or completion claim can reach a role, and that forbidden lifecycle paths are unreadable through model tools.

objectives.title: Determinism of selection
objectives.objective: Falsify the claim that task selection is deterministic and plan-derived: prove selection is a pure function of the committed plan and bound commit, that exactly one task is selected, that priority then lexicographic ID ordering holds, and that no runtime task ledger participates.

objectives.title: Evidence integrity
objectives.objective: Falsify the claim that acceptance evidence is trustworthy: prove exact-commit receipts and manifests bind the real command, identity, commit, and digests; prove PASS requires exit 0 and verified bindings; prove a model assertion, prose claim, or synthetic probe can never elevate evidence or bypass a deterministic gate.

objectives.title: State and transition integrity
objectives.objective: Falsify the claim that the single control-state file is tamper-proof and monotonic: prove the §11 transition table, write-once bindings, monotonic counters, digest ledger, and fail-closed behavior on forged, moved, symlinked, oversized, wrong-mode, or wrong-owner state, and on counter rewinds and illegal transitions.

objectives.title: Writer and process confinement
objectives.objective: Falsify the claim that exactly one writer exists and untrusted processes are confined: prove the root-descriptor lock is non-inheritable and not unlockable by a second descriptor, that the developer is the only product-code writer, and that TERM/INT/HUP reach and reap the full model process group with dirty work preserved.

objectives.title: Credential boundary
objectives.objective: Falsify the claim that credentials cannot leak: prove Ollama cookies appear in no child argv, environment, log, or repository state; prove credential-shaped tool calls and results are blocked or redacted; prove the operator credential store and exact guard source are outside or inaccessible to model tools at the bound commit.

objectives.title: Findings flow
objectives.objective: Falsify the claim that findings reach later developers only through a planner revision of the canonical plan: prove no independent runtime task queue, memory store, or prose authority selects work, and that verification findings and audit results become plan tasks through the planner.

objectives.title: Finite campaign termination
objectives.objective: Falsify the claim that campaigns always terminate within configured bounds: prove finite round and attempt budgets, that empty work reaches verification and audit instead of spinning, that every outcome class (success, findings, blocked, failed, interrupted, infrastructure_failure) terminates, and that no lower completion predicate implies a higher one.
